Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 24, 2026

This policy explains how the Clash of Critters Companion website (“Service”) handles information when you visit or use its account and community features. The Service is operated by the community project under the name kenzkunz.

The Service is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Farlight Games or the game’s rights holders.

Information processed

  • Sign-in information: when you sign in with Discord or Google, the identity provider and Supabase authentication service process account identifiers and may provide basic profile information such as your name, avatar, and email address. The fields available depend on the provider and permissions. The Service does not receive your provider password.
  • Information you enter: display name, game ID, Discord username, and sharing preferences, if you choose to add them.
  • Saved account data: Tatari roster and progression, settings, card collection including foil ownership, exchange preferences and requests, conversations, formations, tierlists, and other account features you use.
  • Community submissions: content you submit to features such as public formations, tierlists, exchange listings, or farm-support tools. Some information may be visible to other users according to the feature and your sharing settings.
  • Browser storage: sign-in session data and local drafts, preferences, or calculator progress may be stored in your browser. Local-only data stays on that browser unless you choose to share it or save it to your account.

How information is used

Information is used to authenticate users, operate and save the features you request, display content to the audience you choose, support account deletion and recovery, protect the Service from misuse, and maintain the site.

We do not sell account information. We do not currently use advertising networks or third-party analytics trackers on the site.

When information is shared

  • With service providers: GitHub Pages hosts the website; Supabase provides authentication and database services; Discord and Google provide sign-in when selected; and Google Fonts serves the site typeface. These providers process connection or account information under their own terms and privacy policies, and may process it in countries where they or their infrastructure operate.
  • With other users: information you publish or choose to share may be visible to other users. Profile contact fields are shared only when their sharing controls are enabled. Messages are available to the conversation participants and the systems needed to deliver them.
  • For safety or legal reasons: information may be disclosed when reasonably necessary to address abuse, protect users or the Service, or meet a valid legal obligation.

Service providers may process technical connection information, such as IP address and browser details, to deliver and secure their services. Their privacy policies explain their handling of that information.

Retention and deletion

Account information is kept while needed to provide the Service and its features. You can delete your account using the account controls where available. The deletion flow removes account-linked profile data, roster and progression, album data, trade requests and preferences, conversations, saved formations, and tierlists from the active Service. Some records may be de-identified where needed to preserve shared site history, and provider backups may retain data temporarily under their normal backup cycles.

Browser-only drafts and preferences can be removed by clearing this site’s browser storage. Deleting your website account does not delete your Discord, Google, or game account.

Your choices

You can choose whether to provide optional profile details, control sharing settings where offered, avoid publishing community content, use local-only features where available, and delete your account. You may also contact us to ask about personal information associated with your account. Depending on where you live, local privacy law may provide additional rights.

Security and children

Reasonable technical and organizational steps are used to protect the Service. No internet service can guarantee absolute security. Please do not send passwords or highly sensitive personal information through community features.

The Service is not intended for children under 13, or a higher minimum age where required by local law. If you believe a child has provided personal information, contact us so we can review the request.

Changes to this policy

This policy may be updated when the Service or its data handling changes. The effective date at the top will be revised when an update is published.

Contact and requests

For privacy questions or requests, contact the site operator through Discord: kenzkunz. You can also use the account deletion control on the website.

Third-party policies: Discord, Google, Supabase, and GitHub.
